summary_1line: Bhishma explains when Brahmanas may adopt other livelihoods, trade restrictions, and when all orders—including Brahmanas—may take up arms to protect order and themselves.

image_candidates.scene_text: A group of ascetic Brahmanas in simple robes stand beside a king, chanting Vedic hymns as their ritual fire blazes to strengthen his faltering power.
A lone Brahmana, normally a priest, lifts a weapon amid chaos as robbers devastate the land and people of all orders prepare to fight.
Bhishma explains to Yudhishthira the analogy of iron striking stone and fire meeting water, illustrating how Kshatriya power weakens before Brahmanas.
